shots.prompt: The empty Phnom Penh factory gate holds still as the camera creeps forward. Night sodium light. [Push in]
The factory worker walks one step toward camera. Badge and slippers stay. [Static shot]
She looks down at the phone. Green screen glow only. [Push in]
She lifts her eyes a little. Face stays the same. [Push in]
She settles the gold sbai once over the factory polo. [Static shot]
The empty shop-front wedding, string bulbs, camera eases in. [Push in]
She stands still in factory slippers at the shop wedding. [Static shot]
The older woman glances down once, jewelry unmoving. [Push in]
A passerby calls out. The groom does not answer and waves him away. [Static shot]
Candlelight holds on the hundred-dollar bills and the ABA success screen. [Static shot]
The mother stands still in the foreground. The girl does not move. [Static shot]
He stands behind her. Both hold still. [Static shot]
From behind, he lifts the gold sbai once. They walk one step. [Tracking shot]
